title: Construction.
officialText:
Concrete formwork, including but not limited to forms, shores, and shoring foundations, shall be
constructed in conformance with the design drawings, where such drawings are required by Section 3305.3.2.1, and shall also be
constructed to comply with the requirements of Sections 3305.3.4.1 through 3305.3.4.5.
